function.name: memory_search
function.description: Search the agent's memory vault for notes matching a query. Use this when the user refers to something from a previous conversation, project, person, or topic.

query.description: Keywords to search for in the vault.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

function.name: memory_read
function.description: Read a single note from the memory vault by its vault-relative path.

path.description: Vault-relative path to the note, e.g. 'projects/website.md'.

function.name: memory_write
function.description: Write or overwrite a note in the memory vault. Use this to remember facts, decisions, project plans, or session summaries.

content.description: Full Markdown content of the note.

function.name: memory_inbox
function.description: Append a quick capture to the inbox for later processing.

function.name: memory_session
function.description: Append a summary to today's session note. Use this at the end of a conversation to record what happened.

text.description: Summary of the session or turn to remember.
